title: Nova Player
full_description: The new Nova Player app gives you unlimited access to all your favourite Nova Stations, an endless playlist of the freshest hits and throwbacks, the latest news, sport and finance on the go, plus hundreds of podcast titles to explore and enjoy. So now you can take Nova wherever you go.Features:- Listen live to Nova Stations wherever you are with local news, traffic and weather.- Keep track of your favourite shows with on-demand catch-up episodes and the latest videos.- Enjoy more music and radio stations than ever before! Switch from Nova to Smooth, FIVEaa and Star 104.5 with a swipe of your thumb.- Access to on-demand news from within the Player sourced from our partners including The Australian, Sky News, The Daily Telegraph, Fox Sports Australia, News.com.au and CBC.- Podcasts. Listen to hundreds of podcast titles in the Nova Podcast Network, choosing from news, sport, comedy and entertainment titles with new content uploaded daily.- Listen with Apple CarPlay- Australia's favourite fresh hits with your favourite shows including Ricki-Lee, Tim & Joel, Smallzy's Surgery, Ben, Liam & Belle, Ash, Luttsy & Susie O'Neill, Fitzy & Wippa with Kate Ritchie, Nathan, Nat & Shaun, Jodie & Hayesy.Listen to:- Nova 96.9 Sydney- Nova 100 Melbourne- Nova 919 Adelaide- Nova 93.7 Perth- Nova 106.9 Brisbane- Nova Throwbacks- Nova 90s- Nova Noughties- Access all of Nova Entertainment's stations including Smooth, Star 104.5 and FIVEaa- PLUS hundreds of podcast titles on the Nova Entertainment Podcast Network
